title: [Nokia] Console baud rate should be 9600 instead of 115200 by default
author: Blueve
body:

#### Description

For Nokia platform, we need the default console baud rate to be 9600 instead of 115200
There are two parts:
1. Image baud rate should be set to 9600 after boot up
2. ONIE image uboot with baud rate 9600

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
N/A

#### Describe the results you received:
Baud rate is 115200

#### Describe the results you expected:
Baud rate is 9600

#### Output of `show version`:
N/A

comments.author: dflynn-Nokia
comments.body:
We (Nokia) have verified operation of the ixs-7215-T1 platform console port at 9600 baud after making manual changes in the u-boot bootloader, ONIE Linux, and Sonic Linux environments. We do have a bit of work to do to automate this and make it the default. We will update this Issue with status as we go.

Note that we have confirmed with our HW team that HW based flow control is not supported in the current HW. We will not be able to provide that on the existing ixs-7215-T1 platform.

linkedPullRequests.title: [Nokia ixs7215] Add support for changing the console baud rate
linkedPullRequests.author: dflynn-Nokia
linkedPullRequests.body:
This commit adds support for changing the default console baud rate configured
within the U-Boot bootloader. That default baud rate is exposed via the value
of the U-Boot 'baudrate' environment variable. This commit removes logic that
hardcoded the console baud rate to 115200 and instead ensures that the U-Boot
'baudrate' variable is always used when constructing the Linux kernel boot
arguments used when booting Sonic.

A change is also made to rc.local to ensure that the specified baud rate is set
correctly in the serial getty service.

#### Why I did it
Allow the default Sonic console baud rate to be changed

#### How I did it
Ensure that the U-Boot console baudrate value is passed as a Linux kernel boot argument.
Ensure that the serial getty service uses this passed baud rate value
